row.body: New tenant what-works (policy evidence atlas). Grades come only from worker/grade.js over curated and read-in trials; a model may only label design and direction with verbatim abstract quotes. Code registered to move to ultrastable/what-works. Worker, D1 and route are added to doctrine/topology.json once the owner confirms the production deploy.
